code_cases.problem_text: Compute n-th Fibonacci number in O(N) time and O(1) space.
code_cases.var_problem_text: Compute n-th Tribonacci number T(n) where T(0)=0, T(1)=1, T(2)=1.
code_cases.solution_code:
def tribonacci(n):
    if n == 0: return 0
    if n <= 2: return 1
    a, b, c = 0, 1, 1
    for _ in range(3, n + 1):
        a, b, c = b, c, a + b + c
    return c
code_cases.test_code:
assert tribonacci(0) == 0
assert tribonacci(1) == 1
assert tribonacci(2) == 1
assert tribonacci(3) == 2
assert tribonacci(4) == 4
assert tribonacci(5) == 7

code_cases.problem_text: Find the k-th smallest element in an unsorted list in O(N) average time.
code_cases.var_problem_text: Find the k most frequent elements in a list.
code_cases.solution_code:
from collections import Counter
def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    counts = Counter(nums)
    return [item for item, _ in counts.most_common(k)]
